scope: Development backend plus local web and mobile source; no production or app-store release

roleAccess.enforcement: Tools filtered using active server-side roles; each existing query also retains its own ownership/role/scope checks. Conversation claims cannot grant access.

voice.flow: Record or choose audio; consent to OpenAI transcription; review/edit transcript; explicitly send; receive text reply in chat
voice.durationValidation: PCM WAV sample counts or native MPEG-4 media duration parsed on server; malformed, empty and overlong recordings rejected. Native codec/device quality still needs verification.
voice.accounting: Reserve the full two-minute estimated allowance before transcription, reconcile returned duration; existing application usage and spending guards retained
voice.privacy: Owned, purpose-bound, malware-checked upload. No user-selected URL fetch. Successful chat transcription requests deletion of the app recording; failed web attempts can be retried or discarded.
voice.intake: Existing form transcription now uses bounded audio reservation; browser recordings converted to PCM for validation.

documents.flow: Photo/capture or upload to private document library; explicit consent to AI description; selected summary passed to the same chat
documents.evidence: An AI description is not original full document text, legal authority or authentication. Private uploads are not indexed into public legal RAG.
documents.mobile: Existing camera/file capture and saved-document description now link to the chat with a selected owned document
documents.web: File/photo chooser and saved-summary selection in composer; failed summary preparation reuses the saved document on retry
